name: Melissa's Adventures
source:
The universe is governed by obscure forces, which humans attempt to survive. Melissa is a woman in exile in France, attempting to navigate challenging issues that extend beyond city borders. One day, fatigued and frustrated by the intricacy of her past decisions, she encounters Nahui, a young man with an Aztec name that translates to "four" in Nahuatl. He, too, is overwhelmed by the multifaceted challenges of his environment and those around him.
The question thus arises as to whether Melissa and Nahui will succeed in establishing a relationship that will enable them to alter the course of events that appear to be predetermined. Furthermore, it remains to be seen whether they will be able to evade the ever-increasing danger that surrounds them by unearthing an ancient artefact.
You are invited to accompany them on their journey.
